name: Zendesk
summary: Customer service platform (ticketing, messaging, voice, help center) with Zendesk AI: AI agents that resolve customer requests across channels without a person, Copilot for human agents, and AutoQA, which scores every interaction. For agents calling in, the vendor publishes the REST API (OAuth access tokens; API tokens deprecated) and an AI Agents API keyed per organization; Zendesk itself is an MCP client that connects to external servers, and publishes no MCP server of its own. Measured: the API answers an anonymous end user on an open instance.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-12 06:06Z, no credentials: GET support.zendesk.com/api/v2/users/me.json answers 200 as "Anonymous user", the documented anonymous end-user access of an open instance. Everything else: OAuth access token per account; API token deprecated. AI Agents API: organization API key.

jobs.summary: Zendesk AI agents, the vendor's words on this page: "Resolve multi-step, multi-intent requests across channels with AI agents that understand intent, ask clarifying questions, and take action across systems"; "complete requests without handoffs"; "resolving requests autonomously". Not measured.

AutoQA, the vendor's words on this page: "Let AI powered QA review every interaction, whether handled by a human or AI agent"; "AutoQA scores the quality of all interactions, including AI agents and voice". Agreement with a trained reviewer's score is not stated. Not measured.
